values.note: Run directly by the Forest Service (Huron Shores Ranger District), not a concessionaire. Every site is reserved by number on recreation.gov April 15 - November 30; December 1 - April 14 no permit or reservation is required. Occupy the site within 24 hours of the reservation's start or it is forfeit unless the Forest Service approves a late arrival. 14 nights in any 30 days.

note: Five drive-in sites on the lowest stretch of the river, about 5 km west of Oscoda near the Whirlpool Angler Access; 100D and 101D are pull-throughs, and 098D (18 ft) is too short for a 23-ft rig. Part of the AuSable River Dispersed Camping system: 102 designated sites along 55 miles of the lower AuSable in the Huron NF, booked as one recreation.gov facility. Dirt or gravel parking aprons; the sites sit on bluffs 5-300 ft above the river and access to the water can be steep. Equipment within 25 ft of the site post; two vehicles and two camping units per site. --Claude
summary: recreation.gov + per-site catalog + FS page: FS-run (Huron Shores RD), $10 Apr 15 - Nov 30 (confirmed), free and no permit Dec 1 - Apr 14, 50% Senior/Access on one site (stated). Five drive-in sites at the pin, four a 23-ft motorhome fits (100D pull-through to 40 ft, 101D pull-through 26, 099D/102D back-in 26); 098D is 18 ft. Added max_rig_ft 40, pull-through, no water/sewer, 14-night limit, URL; season derived opens 04-15 -> year-round (not maintained Dec 1 - Apr 14). Current Huron-Manistee alerts (April 2026 flooding, March 2026 winter storm, Iargo Springs closure) name no AuSable River campsite or road near it; the standing 'Au Sable National Scenic River Camping Restrictions' order only confines camping to designated sites.
